requirements: Review the exact selected boss location access requirements and planned Wilderness risk.
mechanics: Lava dragons use melee (slash) and short-ranged dragonfire (max 50 without protection).
Lava dragons are weak to water spells (50%).
Lava Dragon Isle is deep Wilderness and a popular player-killing hotspot.
All Krystilia lava dragon kills must occur on Lava Dragon Isle in the Wilderness.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Kill lava dragons on Lava Dragon Isle with dragonfire protection and low-risk gear.
requiredOrKeyItems: Craw's bow or Dragon hunter crossbow
steps: Bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport.
Range or melee the lava dragons; their low actual Magic/Ranged levels make ranged accurate.
Watch the minimap for player killers and teleport if threatened.
notes: Lava dragon bones give strong Prayer XP at the nearby Chaos Altar but attract player killers.
The deep-Wilderness location makes escape difficult if attacked.

methods.label: Melee with Dragon hunter lance
methods.summary: Melee lava dragons for faster kills when accepting closer engagement.
requiredOrKeyItems: Dragon hunter lance or Viggora's chainmace
steps: Stand adjacent and melee with a dragonbane weapon for higher damage per hit.
Watch for the short-ranged dragonfire and keep antifire up.
Teleport immediately if a player killer approaches on the isle.
notes: Dragon hunter lance gains its dragonbane bonus against lava dragons.
Melee kills are faster but require standing in melee range in deep Wilderness.

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Transportation
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
[[File:Lava dragon routes.png|right|thumb|Reaching the lava dragons.]]
There are two entrances to Lava Dragon Isle: The main gate on the north side and an [[Agility]] [[shortcut]], a [[Stepping stone (Lava Dragon Isle)|stepping stone]], on the southern side requiring 74 Agility to use.

*The fastest teleport is a [[revenant cave teleport]] and then go north-east to the main entrance.
*[[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Last Man Standing]] ([[Ferox Enclave]]) and then go north to agility shortcut. 
*[[Annakarl teleport]] and go west to the main entrance.
*[[Games necklace]] teleport to the [[Corporeal Beast]] lair, or make a [[waka canoe]] (requiring 57 [[Woodcutting]] and an [[axe]]), and go north to use the Agility shortcut.
*The [[Wilderness lever]], requiring a weapon with [[slash]] bonus or a [[knife]] to cut a web, run south through the deep Wilderness gate to the northern entrance.

Banking can be done at the [[Mage Arena]] bank or via an [[amulet of glory]] by going south to level 30 [[Wilderness]] and teleporting to [[Edgeville]].

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Requirements
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
As always, '''only bring items you are willing to risk'''. It is therefore strongly recommended to only bring [[3-item|3]] or [[4-item]] with a [[Body slot table|top]], [[Legs slot table|bottom]], [[weapon]] and [[shield]], preferably an [[anti-dragon shield]]. Anything else should be expendable and easily obtainable, such as [[God cape]], [[God book|book]], or [[Achievement Diary|diary]] items.

At 74 [[Agility]], an [[Agility shortcut]] becomes available for back-door access in the south. Furthermore, completion of the elite [[Wilderness Diary]] grants noted [[bones]] in the [[Wilderness]].

reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
[[File:Looting bag detail.png|left|60x60px]]
For the inventory, you want to bring some [[food]], [[runes]] if not using a [[powered staff]] or [[Ranged]], a [[looting bag]], [[pestle and mortar]] (to grind up [[Lava scale|scales]], but optional), and a [[games necklace]] if teleporting to the [[Corporeal Beast]] cave. A [[stamina potion]] could help for [[running]], but if taking potions, it's recommended to take a [[stamina]], [[saradomin brew]], [[super restore]], and a [[ranging potion]] if ranging with the latter omitted if [[maging]] instead.
As for food, it is recommended to take four to six [[lobster]]s or better.
